mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Federal Reserve to delay rate hikes or initiate easing, boosting equity valuations through lower real rates and improved risk appetite over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to generate a positive Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 850,000 units in two consecutive months signals a contraction in residential investment, which typically precedes a broader demand slowdown; this triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 97.0 for two consecutive months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal’s Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1.0% and CPI inflation is above 2.5%, the market expects a tightening cycle to follow, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment growth above 200,000 per month combined with a declining unemployment rate signals strong labor market momentum, which may lead to inflationary pressures and faster Fed tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 410,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, combined with a contraction in GDP growth (GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized), indicates a weakening consumer-driven economy, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal’s Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
